Job Summary

Copilot Studio Developer with 3.6 years of experience in Power Platform or conversational AI development. The role involves designing and developing AI-powered conversational agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and integrating them with enterprise systems through Power Automate, APIs, and connectors. Experience in enterprise Power Platform solutions and AI conversational systems is preferred. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical, automation, troubleshooting, and communication skills to build scalable and efficient AI-driven enterprise solutions successfully.

Responsibilities
Creating conversational flows, topic routing, adaptive cards, orchestration, knowledge source integration, RAG-based responses, and implementing human-in-the-loop workflows while ensuring governance and security compliance.
Requirements
Experience in Power Platform or conversational AI development.
Designing and developing AI-powered conversational agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
Integrating with enterprise systems through Power Automate, APIs, and connectors.
Experience in enterprise Power Platform solutions and AI conversational systems (preferred).
Strong analytical, automation, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
Ability to build scalable and efficient AI-driven enterprise solutions.
Knowledge of governance and security compliance.
